descriptor: Independent type foundry with variable fonts

voice.summary: Marrow Type writes with the dry authority of a type specimen: exact about weight, width and slant, and quietly proud of its drawings. It lets the letters carry the personality.
dos: Use type terms correctly: weight, slant, optical size
Lead with the glyphs, then the description
Show real characters instead of describing them
donts: Do not use fancy words for ordinary shapes
Never present a font without a specimen

taglines: Weight and slant, in your hands
Try the word. Test the weight
boilerplate: Marrow Type is an independent type foundry releasing variable fonts with live specimens, so designers can test weight, slant and glyphs before they license.

microcopy.error: That character is not in this font.
microcopy.empty: Type a word to see it set.

logo.note: A bold letterform is the natural mark for a type foundry.
